source._comment: STAGED SKELETON. Ballots mailed to all active voters; returned by town (town->county). Source pointer: https://sos.vermont.gov/elections/ . The specific machine-readable turnout feed is identified & wired by the Oct rollout routine (real parser where a persistent file exists, else live-feed capture). Reads 0 until then.
source._standin: Until the official source posts (or is wired), the connector writes a UF Election Lab stand-in via scripts/lab_standin.py (US.csv + VT_county.csv when available; unaltered, attributed, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0). Official data replaces it automatically.
